title: Job Interviews (Part 2)
completion_message: ¡Fantástico! Ahora estás preparado para responder las preguntas más comunes en una entrevista de trabajo.

parts.visual: Preguntas comunes: 'Tell me about yourself' (Háblame de ti). 'Why do you want to work here?' (¿Por qué quieres trabajar aquí?). 'Why did you leave your last job?' (¿Por qué dejaste tu último trabajo?).
parts.audio: Common questions. Tell me about yourself. Why do you want to work here? Why did you leave your last job?

parts.visual: Más preguntas: 'Where do you see yourself in five years?' (¿Dónde te ves en cinco años?). 'How do you handle pressure?' (¿Cómo manejas la presión?). Respuestas útiles: 'I am a team player' (Trabajo bien en equipo). 'I am looking for a new challenge' (Busco un nuevo reto).
parts.audio: More questions. Where do you see yourself in five years? How do you handle pressure? Useful answers: I am a team player. I am looking for a new challenge.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta o palabra correcta para esta entrevista de trabajo.

questions.question: Could you ____ me about yourself? (Hablarme / Contarme).
questions.explanation: Tell me about yourself = háblame / cuéntame sobre ti.

questions.question: ____ do you want to work for our company? (¿Por qué?).
questions.explanation: Why do you want to work here? = ¿Por qué quieres trabajar aquí?

questions.question: Why did you ____ your last job? (Dejar/Renunciar).
questions.explanation: Leave a job = dejar un trabajo.

questions.question: Where do you ____ yourself in five years? (Te ves).
questions.explanation: Where do you see yourself...? = ¿Dónde te ves a ti mismo...?

questions.question: I am looking for a new ____. (Reto / Desafío).
questions.explanation: Looking for a new challenge = buscando un nuevo reto profesional.

questions.question: I consider myself a ____ player. (Persona que trabaja en equipo).
questions.explanation: Team player = alguien que trabaja bien en equipo.

questions.question: I have a ____ in Business Administration. (Título universitario).
questions.explanation: Degree = título universitario (Bachelor's degree, Master's degree).

questions.question: I am very ____ to detail. (Orientado al detalle).
Why should we ____ you? (Contratarte).
questions.explanation: Why should we hire you? = ¿Por qué deberíamos contratarte?

questions.question: I am a very ____ person. I always want to improve and grow. (Ambicioso).
questions.explanation: Ambitious = ambicioso (en un sentido positivo profesional).

questions.question: I am ____ to work weekends if necessary. (Dispuesto).
I left my last job because there was no room for ____. (Crecimiento).
questions.explanation: Room for growth = espacio para crecer / oportunidad de crecimiento.

questions.question: I am very ____. I never arrive late. (Puntual).
Do you have any ____ for us? (Preguntas).
questions.explanation: Do you have any questions for us? (Típica pregunta final en la entrevista).

questions.question: I am a quick ____. I adapt easily to new software. (Aprendiz).
questions.explanation: Quick learner (o fast learner) = persona que aprende rápido.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave para responder en la entrevista.

questions.question: Why did you ____ your last job? (Dejar/Renunciar)
I am looking for a new ____. (Desafío / Reto)
I am a ____ player. (Trabajo en equipo)
I have a ____ in Marketing. (Título universitario)

pairs.source: I am looking for a new challenge

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la pregunta de entrevista.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Why do you want to work here?
options: Why do you want to work here?
Why do you want to work for us?
Where do you want to work here?
Why would you want to work here?
questions.correct_answer: Why do you want to work here?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Why did you leave your last job?
options: Why did you leave your last job?
Why did you quit your last job?
When did you leave your last job?
Why did you lose your last job?
questions.correct_answer: Why did you leave your last job?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Where do you see yourself in five years?
options: Where do you see yourself in five years?
Where do you see yourself in two years?
How do you see yourself in five years?
Where do you want to be in five years?
questions.correct_answer: Where do you see yourself in five years?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am looking for a new challenge.
options: I am looking for a new challenge.
I am looking for a new job.
I am looking for a new project.
We are looking for a new challenge.
questions.correct_answer: I am looking for a new challenge.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: I am a good team player.
